# Shared netlist-guard cases, checked by Python (tests/test_hdl_pv_spice.py), JavaScript
# (tests/js/guard.mjs) and Rust (desktop/netlist-guard). Format: a line "=== ok <name>" or
# "=== reject <name>" starts a case; the netlist follows until the next "===" line.
=== ok plain-rc
* good
V1 in 0 DC 12
R1 in out 1k
C1 out 0 1u
.tran 1u 1m
.meas tran vavg AVG v(out)
.end
=== ok title-line-is-not-parsed
* shell write load: words in the title line are ignored, like SPICE does
V1 in 0 DC 1
R1 in 0 1
.op
.end
=== ok comments-may-mention-anything
* t
* .control shell rm -rf ~  (a comment, never executed)
V1 in 0 DC 1
R1 in 0 1
.op
.end
=== ok behavioural-source-and-bjt
* t
V1 in 0 DC 1
B1 out 0 V=v(in)*2
Q1 c b 0 QMOD
.model QMOD NPN
.save all
.op
.end
=== ok meg-suffix-tran
* t
V1 in 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 5u 10u)
R1 in 0 1meg
.tran 100n 1m
.end
=== reject control-block-shell
* t
V1 in 0 DC 1
.control
shell rm -rf ~
.endc
.end
=== reject control-uppercase
* t
V1 in 0 DC 1
.CONTROL
run
.ENDC
.end
=== reject include
* t
.include /etc/passwd
.end
=== reject lib
* t
.lib /tmp/x.lib tt
.end
=== reject exec
* t
.exec shell ls
.end
=== reject too-many-points
* t
V1 in 0 DC 1
.tran 1p 10
.end
=== reject too-many-points-uppercase
* t
V1 in 0 DC 1
.TRAN 1n 10
.end
=== reject unknown-element
* t
Z1 in out 1k
.end
=== reject xspice-code-model
* t
A1 in out filt
.end
=== reject option-continuation-shell
* t
.option
+ shell=1
.end
=== reject write-in-param
* t
.param x = write
.end
=== reject unknown-dot
* t
.measure_and_run x
.end
=== reject malformed-tran
* t
.tran fast
.end
